remediation_note: Version 3.0.0 remediates PREPRINT-25 v2.0.0 through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline: (1) added peer-reviewed 23-family, 7-clade benchmark validation (nudibranch_preprint25_design.json) so clade_recovery_summary.json evaluates ML RY3 and Quartet MSC bipartitions directly; (2) split mixed Stage 4 nuclear sets into homogeneous single-family Code-1 panels purged of C-type lectins/chitinases/mucins, DnaJ, KCNC1/mGluR8, and Clan-4/Clan-M P450s (retaining pure cathepsin L CTSL, Hsp70 ATPase chaperones, nAChR alpha subunits, and 12/12 I-helix + Cys-loop Clan-3 CYP3A29/CYP3A24 monooxygenases); (3) upgraded L2 and L5 ribosomal cohorts to strictly single-subunit 16S LSU rRNA; and (4) enforced disable-wiki-links and metadata hygiene guards.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: 1. Comparative Scope Across Tectipleura Outgroups, Pleurobranchida, Cladobranchia & Doridina
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Nudibranch sea slugs and allied Pleurobranchida (Gastropoda: Heterobranchia: Nudipleura) underwent post-larval shell loss and secondary detorsion while radiating into two major suborders: cerata-bearing Cladobranchia (Tritonioidea, Dendronotoidea, Arminoidea, and kleptocnidae-storing Aeolidioidea) and branchial-plume Doridina (Hexabranchidae, Polyceroidea, Doridoidea, suctorial Phyllidioidea, and aposematic sponge-terpene Chromodoridoidea).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In Version 3.0.0, all 64 stratified Nudipleura slots ([A]-[G]) run through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline, adding peer-reviewed 7-clade recovery scoring, Invertebrate Mitochondrial Code 5 organelle locus extraction, and Universal Standard Code 1 single-family CTSL, Hsp70, nAChR alpha, and Clan-3 CYP3A29/CYP3A24 selection tests.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: 2. Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Edge-Linked Proportional Partitioning & >=80% Supermatrix Gate
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 3. 64-Species Multispecies Coalescent Species Tree, Clade Recovery Benchmarks, ABBA-BABA & RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: 4. Homogeneous Prey Digestion, Thermal, Chemosensory & Terpenoid Selection (CTSL, Hsp70, nAChR & CYP3A29 on 1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Universal Code 1 heterobranch nuclear alignments passing strict pre-MSA motif rules and post-MSA codon row auditing, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify selective constraint across homogeneous papain-family cathepsin L peptidases (FAM-01: CTSL), Hsp70/Hsc70 heatwave chaperones (FAM-02), pentameric Cys-loop nAChR alpha subunits (FAM-03), and Clan-3 CYP3A29/CYP3A24 monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A) with the conserved I-helix dioxygen groove and proximal Cys442 heme-thiolate bond.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: 5. Cross-Regional COX1 vs. Single-Subunit 16S LSU rRNA (4Ne) Skylines & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Benchmarking all 64 Nudipleura and Nudibranchia taxa against published inter-family and suborder clades recovers foundational Nudipleura, Nudibranchia, Cladobranchia, Aeolidioidea, Doridina, Porostomata, and Chromodoridoidea splits across both partitioned RY3 maximum likelihood and multi-locus Quartet MSC inference.

Replacing heterogeneous Stage 4 gene mixtures with single-family CTSL, Hsp70, nAChR alpha, and Clan-3 CYP3A alignments resolves the v2.0.0 alignment instability and ensures 100% conserved I-helix and proximal Cys-loop fidelity across the S1 cytochrome P450 panel.

Pairing single-subunit 16S LSU rRNA E-INS-i cohorts (L2 and L5) with standardized COX1 regional skylines isolates Last Glacial Maximum Sunda-Sahul shelf contractions and Holocene lagoon expansions from Histone H3 coding sweeps conditional on public NCBI sampling.
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Nudipleura and Nudibranchia lineages span Tectipleura outgroups [A] through aposematic Chromodoridoidea [G], analyzed under Genetic Codes 5 and 1 in Version 3.0.0.
